raw.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, in HIT determination simulations the y and z motion of the vehicle model shall be constrained and the x-direction motion shall not be constrained.

candidates.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, the selected HBMs are those whose head hits the DPPS properly (head contacts the DPPS and, at that time, the x-coordinate of the head CoG lies between the smallest and largest x-coordinate of the DPPS at y=0); simulations with the next tallest HBM shall also be performed to prove that it does not hit the DPPS properly.

raw.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, the selected HBMs are those whose head hits the DPPS properly (head contacts the DPPS and, at that time, the x-coordinate of the head CoG lies between the smallest and largest x-coordinate of the DPPS at y=0); simulations with the next tallest HBM shall also be performed to prove that it does not hit the DPPS properly.

candidates.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, if only one HBM hits the DPPS properly, the next tallest HBM shall also belong to the selected HBMs.

raw.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, if only one HBM hits the DPPS properly, the next tallest HBM shall also belong to the selected HBMs.

candidates.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, each HIT determination simulation shall generate time history curves of x and z coordinates of HC and AC, x displacement of vehicle CoG, resultant HC acceleration, contact forces (vehicle–HBM without upper extremities, vehicle–head, total), total hourglass and internal energies, and mass increase, all plotted every 0.1 ms or less.

candidates.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, animations of each HIT determination simulation shall be generated with an output interval of 1 ms.

candidates.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, in each HIT determination simulation the contact force between HBM and vehicle shall be zero at simulation start.

raw.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, in each HIT determination simulation the contact force between HBM and vehicle shall be zero at simulation start.

candidates.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, in each HIT determination simulation the total energy shall remain constant within a 15 per cent tolerance.

raw.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, in each HIT determination simulation the total energy shall remain constant within a 15 per cent tolerance.

candidates.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, in each HIT determination simulation the hourglass energy shall be ≤ 10 per cent of the total energy.

raw.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, in each HIT determination simulation the hourglass energy shall be ≤ 10 per cent of the total energy.

candidates.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, in each HIT determination simulation the artificial mass increase shall be less than 3 per cent.

raw.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, in each HIT determination simulation the artificial mass increase shall be less than 3 per cent.

candidates.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, in HIT determination simulations the coefficient of friction between vehicle and HBM shall be 0.3.

raw.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, in HIT determination simulations the coefficient of friction between vehicle and HBM shall be 0.3.

candidates.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, HIT shall be calculated as the time elapsed between the first contact of the HBM (neglecting forearms and hands) with the vehicle outer surface and the first contact of its head with the vehicle outer surface, first contact being the first time the contact force is non-zero; if this method is not applicable, an appropriate alternative method may be applied and shall be reported.

raw.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, HIT shall be calculated as the time elapsed between the first contact of the HBM (neglecting forearms and hands) with the vehicle outer surface and the first contact of its head with the vehicle outer surface, first contact being the first time the contact force is non-zero; if this method is not applicable, an appropriate alternative method may be applied and shall be reported.

candidates.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, the WAD corresponding to HIT shall be determined by projecting the head CoG point (Xhead, 0, Zhead) at the time of first head contact with the DPPS orthogonally onto the surface of the undeployed vehicle (highest x value if multiple projection points) and computing the WAD of that point rounded to the nearest full millimetre.

raw.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, the WAD corresponding to HIT shall be determined by projecting the head CoG point (Xhead, 0, Zhead) at the time of first head contact with the DPPS orthogonally onto the surface of the undeployed vehicle (highest x value if multiple projection points) and computing the WAD of that point rounded to the nearest full millimetre.

candidates.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, if HIT_d ≥ TRT for all selected HBMs, HIT simulations on the undeployed DPPS are not required.

raw.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, if HIT_d ≥ TRT for all selected HBMs, HIT simulations on the undeployed DPPS are not required.

candidates.text: For a vehicle with DPPS, based on the HIT_d results of the deployed DPPS simulations, a WAD versus HIT_d graph using a linear regression line shall be plotted for comparison with TRT.
